summary: At the October 8, 2026 Rider University debate, Murphy excluded Gaza entirely from his Israel-Palestine framing, reducing the conflict to West Bank settler violence and calling settlers 'a deviation' from Israelis who 'want peace.' In August, on The Capitol Show, he positioned his foreign policy around 'pro-Israel alignment' and continued U.S. support for Israel. His call for tougher pressure on settlers remains nested within that structure, with no acknowledgment of the war in Gaza.
